error_description: The file type of the image is not supported
next_best_action: Upload an image that is in either of .jpeg or .jpg or .png formats

error_description: The file size exceeds the permissible limits
next_best_action: Upload an image of smaller size

error_description: The uploaded image is not clear. This can either be due to poor resolution or because part of the image is cropped
next_best_action: Upload an image with better quality without any cropping of the form

error_description: The ID of the uploaded form does not match with that in our records
next_best_action: Check that the form is uploaded against the correct order ID

error_description: The signature of the customer is either missing or could not be detected
next_best_action: Check that the customer has signed in the appropriate box and that the image uploaded is clear. For current account a company stamp may also be required

error_description: One or more of the fields on the NACH form do not match with that in our records
next_best_action: Check that the image is clear and that the data has not been tampered with before uploading again

error_description: A form against this order is pending action on the destination bank. A new form cannot be submitted till a status is received
next_best_action: Wait for an update from the destination bank on the approval/rejection of the mandate
